banner.title: Your privacy on this demo site
banner.text: This site uses only what it needs to work, unless you allow more. With your consent it also loads content from other services, such as videos, which may store data in your browser and use what they learn for their own purposes. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time, from the bottom of every page.

dialog.title: Privacy settings
dialog.introduction: Choose what the site may load and store beyond what it needs to work. Each category lists its services, who provides them, what they store and for how long. Your choice holds for 12 months. You can change or withdraw it at any time from the footer of every page.

notice.withdrawn: Your consents have been withdrawn. The page will reload.
